title: Wellbeing is in the work
sub: Film 2 of People first, in Leading data people: what people need from work, and where a manager looks first. Fourteen urgent requests wait on one analyst, in no order. Her manager doesn't ask her to cope: they put her week on one page, agree an order with the people who asked, and ask the whole team the same five questions in writing.
howto: The film is drawn in ink line: flat colour with one even dark line, and whole people in the places where they work and meet, at a gorge in the Andes and at the university. Its ideas are written by hand: at the team's board, where a consultant explains them, and in Helena's notebook. Its colours mean the same in every film: blue is plans (the order agreed, and its dates), green is something done or something that helps, and amber a cost, a risk or waiting (what the work asks, and what wears people out). People wear none of them.
